finding.title: Directional-light score is tautological and produces a hard vertical cutoff
evidence: build_maw_motion_evidence.py constructs a rectangular gate at pivot_x and then reports left/right facing fraction as the literal constant 1.0
Neither implementation reads the atlas normal rect, so the current metric cannot demonstrate normal-dependent lighting or darkness falloff
finding.impact: The evidence can pass >=0.75 by construction while rendering a binary half-sprite, so CI success is not proof of Selective Pixel Rim Lighting.

assertions: reported light_facing_fraction is exactly 1.0 for both directions
light boundary is the manifest pivot x=108 rather than a normal-dot-light contour

acceptance_for_build_slot.implementation: Generate eight palette-quantized directional detail variants from the existing normal tiles at build time; runtime selects/interpolates variants without CPU per-pixel work.
required_tests: record normal tile SHA and normalized light vector for every evidence frame
facing-half lit fraction >=0.75 for left and right
no continuous vertical brightness seam at pivot longer than 4 art pixels
left/right matched captures use identical jaw phase, camera, seed and resolution
body alpha remains 255 on occupied silhouette pixels and colors remain within the canonical seven-color palette
